notes.title: Patch #1
notes.notes:
First Patch for Frontline Heroes VR is out

[h1]General updates:[/h1]
[olist]
 [*]Add Ammo function to Weapons, ammo must be buy in weapon shop! 
every weapon has a starter pack of ammo
 [*]Change Money per Kill from 25 to 50
 [*]Add Hero Red Hit Effect 
 [*]Small performance improvements
 [*]Small Bug Fixes
[/olist]
If you found Bugs with the Ammo System please post here or in Forum.
